verdict.rationale: No dedicated sandbox or test environment is documented. Isolation is only possible through workarounds. One is running the open-source engine, described as 'the same memory engine as the Platform', on your own infrastructure as a separate instance. Others are separating memories by app or project scope, or having an agent create a fresh account and API key from the terminal. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/test-mode environment, documented separation of test and production keys or projects, guidance on seeding or resetting test data, and any hands-on corroboration.
